method: Second source/target and assertion consistency pass across all 144 saved handoffs after first-pass reading; same operator, not independent raters. Rechecked omissions versus supported implications and applied cross-block ambiguity rules.

root_checks.01: All numerical, scope, rollback and uncertainty targets checked across 12 outputs. Keep strict ambiguity only for unknown—not recorded without supplied-evidence qualification. Missing approval is never silently scored as denied.
root_checks.02: All time/currentness/dependence/authorization facts checked across 12 outputs. O can be omitted when the unique 08:40 pre-restart observation remains unambiguously identified. True no-original-source context caveats are supported by requests, not unsupported world-status additions.
root_checks.03: All generation, passed-test, copy and authorization facts checked. No passed G8 test established weakens no G8 result available; apply identical e06-loss rule across both blocks.
root_checks.04: All current/old window, planned interval, inclusive endpoints, unchanged plan, rollback and superseded-reminder targets checked. Reflects superseded schedule is accepted as a paraphrase of copies the superseded schedule.
root_checks.05: All old/current item prices, aggregate cap, eligibility and same-item provenance checked. Arithmetic 60+50=110 is supported; no extra purchases or allowances inferred.
root_checks.06: All scope, inspection/receipt and L3 damage/approval limits checked. Calling clarification a correction is ambiguous noncritical framing; it does not alter lot facts or eligibility.
root_checks.07: All field-set, destination, consent-request and unchanged-export facts checked. Same-receipt provenance absent without a definite receipt link is lost; adds no fields to the receipt keeps ambiguous co-reference, identically in both scoring views.
root_checks.08: All version/site exception conditions, tests, rollback and audit status checked. Does not cover other sites follows the explicit East-only exception; it is not an invented new restriction.
root_checks.09: All versions, acknowledgements, latest-state and authorization checked. Earlier K7 does not explicitly retain initial status; omitted forwarded provenance is separately lost. Those historical losses do not equal decision harm.
root_checks.10: All current passing checks, independent origins, old symptoms, approval and optional monitor checked. Missing must-pass rule conjunct is lost; permits when/after versus only-if remains ambiguous rather than forced into a favorable score.
root_checks.11: All role/account/receipt/reminder facts checked. Missing author-not-data-owner is distinct from missing data-owner approval; shared-identifier evidence can be lost while one-approval conclusion survives. Correction framing kept ambiguous/noncritical.
root_checks.12: All rule, threshold correction, equality, unchanged measurement, whole-batch provenance and duplicate-measurement facts checked. Apply latest rule with explicit current equality preserves the operative relation; no demand for verbatim wording.
